description: An AI editor. Every answer shows the page it came from and highlights the quote. Free, open-source desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux: check your own drafts against your documents, take meeting notes on your computer. Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Ollama. A NotebookLM alternative.
summary: IncarnaMind is a free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux where you ask questions about your own documents (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and more) and write with AI. Every answer cites the exact page, and IncarnaMind checks that each quoted passage is really there.
